# Mago for VS Code

> VS Code extension that integrates the [Mago](https://github.com/carthage-software/mago) PHP static analysis tool, providing lint, analyze, format, and baseline operations with full diagnostics integration.

Mago for VS Code brings PHP linting, analysis, formatting, and baseline management directly into the editor. Issues surface in VS Code's native Problems pane, with optional auto-run on save for lint, analyze, and format.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Feature overview, commands, configuration, and installation instructions.
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): Full version history.
- [TESTING](TESTING.md): How to run and write tests for the extension.

## Commands

- `Mago: Lint Current File` / `Mago: Lint Project`: Run Mago's lint checks.
- `Mago: Analyze Current File` / `Mago: Analyze Project`: Run Mago's static analysis.
- `Mago: Lint & Analyze Current File` / `Mago: Lint & Analyze Project`: Run both in one pass.
- `Mago: Format Current File` / `Mago: Format Project`: Format PHP code with Mago's formatter.
- `Mago: Format Check (CI)`: Verify formatting without modifying files.
- `Mago: Generate Lint Baseline` / `Mago: Generate Analyze Baseline`: Create baseline files to suppress existing issues.

## Configuration

- `mago.lintOnSave` (default: `true`): Run lint automatically on file save.
- `mago.analyzeOnSave` (default: `true`): Run analyze automatically on file save.
- `mago.formatOnSave` (default: `false`): Format automatically on file save.
- `mago.lintBaseline`: Path to the lint baseline file.
- `mago.analyzeBaseline`: Path to the analyze baseline file.
- `mago.executablePath` (default: `mago`): Path to the Mago executable.

## Optional

- [Repository](https://github.com/hidao80/mago-vsx): Source code, issues, and CI workflows.
- [Mago](https://github.com/carthage-software/mago): The underlying PHP static analysis tool this extension wraps.
